surface.label: Cursor rules
surface.verified: Cursor project rules (.cursor/rules/*.mdc, description + alwaysApply + globs); alwaysApply: false with globs is "auto-attached when a matching file is in context", and the docs warn that alwaysApply: false with no description is manual @-mention only
surface.note: The only surface that reads `.mdc`. Every other row here is a plain `.md` or a symlink.

loader.label: Cursor

start.why: Cursor rules docs: alwaysApply: true alone means the rule is always included; alwaysApply: false attaches on a matching file, on a description match, or only on an @-mention
Cursor rules docs: AGENTS.md is supported in the project root and in subdirectories, combined with parent files, with the more specific one winning

alsoReads.why: Cursor rules docs: globs auto-attach on a matching file, a description lets the model decide, and a rule with neither loads only on an @-mention
Cursor rules docs: precedence is Team Rules, then Project Rules, then User Rules; the latter two are configured in the app, not in a file this tool can project

loader.order: team rules, then project rules, then user rules
loader.capNote: no byte cap published; the docs recommend keeping rules under 500 lines, which is guidance and not a limit the reader enforces

imports.why: Cursor rules docs: an @file in a rule body is not inlined — "the file's contents are not inlined into the prompt"

loader.nested: cumulative — nested AGENTS.md files are combined with their parents and the more specific one wins; .cursor/rules/ may hold folders
loader.skillsNote: no project skill directory is documented for Cursor

agents.verified: Cursor subagents docs (cursor.com/docs/subagents, read 2026-10-30): project subagents are markdown files with name and description frontmatter under .cursor/agents/

mcp.verified: Cursor MCP docs (read 2026-10-14): "Create .cursor/mcp.json in your project"

loader.verified: Cursor rules documentation (cursor.com/docs/context/rules, read 2026-10-14) — only .cursor/rules/*.mdc is read, a plain .md there is ignored; alwaysApply decides whether a rule costs bytes at start; @file references in a rule body are not inlined; AGENTS.md is read in the project root and in subdirectories, combined with parents
loader.note: A rule with alwaysApply: false is listed under alsoReads rather than start, because it costs nothing until something matches.
